description: Approve, reject, or cancel a pending human-approval gate. Requires the gate resolveToken (found in the gate record via tidebase_get_run, or in the gate.created webhook payload). Gates resolve exactly once: a second attempt returns a conflict. Only resolve a gate when the human you are assisting has explicitly made the decision.

actor.description: Who decided, for the audit record

runId.description: Run id the gate belongs to

name: tidebase_resolve_gate
title: Resolve an approval gate
